quotations.old_english: Gielde he fulwíte [fullwíte MSS. B. H.] let him pay the full fine

source_text: ful-wíte, full-wíte, es; n. A full fine; pl&e-long;na mulcta :-- Gielde he fulwíte [fullwíte MSS. B. H.] let him pay the full fine, L. In. 43; Th. i. 128, 18: 72; Th. 1. 148, 8: L. C. S. 49; Th. i. 404, 9, note 18, MS. G.
